name: my-ai-tools
description: Personal marketplace for agent skills, commands, plugins, and MCP tools.

plugins.name: lkml-mcp
plugins.description: MCP server for Linux Kernel Mailing List threads, patches, and reviews via lore.kernel.org

plugins.name: commit
plugins.description: Smart Git commit with Linux Kernel style messages and DCO sign-off

plugins.name: cover
plugins.description: Generate Linux Kernel style cover letters from git commit history

plugins.name: rhel-jira
plugins.description: RHEL Kernel JIRA workflow assistant for RHEL, RHELTEST, and RHELMISC. Requires a configured Jira MCP server exposing jira_* tools.

plugins.name: analyze
plugins.description: Strategic architecture and codebase analysis: tech debt, scalability, and long-term fit.

plugins.name: challenge
plugins.description: Adversarial pushback on claims, prior answers, and assumptions that may not hold.

plugins.name: chat
plugins.description: Collaborative technical brainstorming and discussion of engineering decisions.

plugins.name: clink
plugins.description: Delegate a task to Gemini, Claude, or Codex CLI for a second-model opinion.

plugins.name: codereview
plugins.description: Code and PR review for bugs, quality issues, and maintainability problems.

plugins.name: consensus
plugins.description: Evaluate proposals and compare approaches from multiple perspectives.

plugins.name: debug
plugins.description: Root-cause analysis for bugs, crashes, failing tests, and unexpected behavior.

plugins.name: docgen
plugins.description: Generate documentation, docstrings, and doc comments for code.

plugins.name: planner
plugins.description: Implementation plans, migration strategies, and technical roadmaps.

plugins.name: precommit
plugins.description: Validate staged changes, diffs, and PRs before committing.

plugins.name: refactor
plugins.description: Refactor code to reduce complexity, decompose large units, and improve organization.

plugins.name: secaudit
plugins.description: Security audit against OWASP Top 10 and code-level vulnerability patterns.

plugins.name: testgen
plugins.description: Generate unit and integration tests with edge-case and failure-mode coverage.

plugins.name: thinkdeep
plugins.description: Deep collaborative reasoning through design decisions, trade-offs, and second opinions.

plugins.name: tracer
plugins.description: Trace call chains, execution flow, and code dependencies with file:line evidence.

plugins.name: kernel-tutorial-writer
plugins.description: In-depth tutorial-style write-ups of Linux kernel subsystems, grounded in the source tree on disk

plugins.name: evangelizador-infantil
plugins.description: Planeja roteiros autônomos de evangelização infantil espírita.
